main_text.head: 22. FOELIX quartus.
main_text.p: Foelix quartus, Samnita, in cura pastorali ut valde solicitus: reiecto praedicationis officio, Cosmae et Damiani fanum exaedificauit, Saturnini templum restituit, aliaque mortuorum hominum templa refecit. Missas in locis consecratis tantum fieri praecepit, clerum a populo in Ecclesiis discreuit, patriarcham Constantinopolitanum de haeresi notatum excommunicauit, defunctis sacrificulis successores post biduum dari statuit: et ut morientes ungerentur adiurato oleo distinctius madauit (pontificalia certe officia) cōfessōrq; anno Domini 530. demum decessit.
main_text.head: 23. BONIFACIVS fecundus.
main_text.p: Bonifacius secundus, Romanus, clericis inter se dissentientibus, non sine acri contentione creatus pontifex: canones quosdam edidit, praecipue, ut tertio die in demortui pontificis locum alius surrogaretur, ordinauit. Populum a clero, Foelicem secutum, in sacris audiendis diuisit, duplici cautela: ut eos in electione pontificum, suis vocibus ac locis tandem priuaret: et ne cuiquam eorum liceret, in ciuili uel criminali causa, Episcopum aut clericum ad secularem iudicem uocare. Sed uide quid miseris illis (meo quidem iudicio) ex hac arrogantia euenerit, dum per capita rasa, digitos unctos, et fa-cella

page.notes: Printed text is in mixed roman and italic; the original has an erroneous reading "Samnium" (printed "Samuis" / "Samnitas"), kept as printed where legible. The last line is partly in tight spacing and the word "cella" (catchword-like, end of line) is treated as the last word of the paragraph; it is not a catchword because it is set within the text block. Several words in the first paragraph are doubtful: "Samuis", "clerum", "morituros/mortuorum", and "cōfessōrq;" are uncertain. The word "Foelicem" in the second paragraph is read as printed. The left-margin reference marks (small dashes and tails) are not text and are not transcribed. Running head and page number are as printed.
